# Data Scientist, Product
Lumenfield · Full-time

What you'll do

- Design and analyze A/B tests for consumer features.
- Partner with product and engineering on metrics.

Requirements

- 1+ years of experience in analytics or data science.
- Advanced SQL.
- Proficiency in Python with pandas.
- Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
- Strong statistics: hypothesis testing and regression.

Nice to have

- Experience with causal inference methods.
- Tableau or Looker.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Lumenfield is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
